title: Playroom Letter Hunt
hook: Match the toy to the space it needs.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: bright 3D playroom storybook, rounded safe toys, simple uncluttered scenes; visual identity: Playroom Letter Hunt

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child choosing a safe play zone
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: toy fact plus suitable-space note when important
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Turn Playroom Letter Hunt into a room-zoning hunt: tabletop, floor-building, soft-play, pretend-story and outdoor/movement toys are separated so a Kite, Jump Rope, Scooter or Unicycle is not treated as ordinary indoor playroom use.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: The child finds a toy, then decides where it can be used safely rather than simply grabbing it.
